setlist.title: If I Had The World To Give

liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **If I Had The World To Give** (4 reviews): Reviewer says the song was played live only about three times and praises Jerry's playing on it; The band reportedly disliked this song and played it only three times, per The Annotated Grateful Dead Lyrics [7][10][13][14]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Reviewer finds Estimated Prophet exploratory, and Iko Iko a special treat; The Estimated>Other One>Eyes jam is described as full of small twists and flourishes [16][18]
- **Iko Iko** (2 reviews): Reviewer says this Iko Iko was paired with another piece as filler on an old tape and has long been a favorite; Reviewer describes the Iko Iko as sitting in a very nice, bouncy groove [7][10]
- **Sugaree** (1 review): Reviewer calls the Sugaree a monster version that stands out in an otherwise so-so first set [14]
- **I Need A Miracle** (1 review): Reviewer singles out the Miracle jam, along with World To Give, as the show's highlights [15]
- **Eyes Of The World** (1 review): Reviewer hears a very relaxed Eyes, with Jerry playing unhurried scales in a jazzy style [16]
- **Space** (1 review): Drum/space section includes Phil's vocalizing leading into the next song [18]

## The recordings

- **gd1978-08-30.145135.sony.ecm270.nak301.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648** (recommended): audience recording; 18 songs; 196 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]
- **gd78-08-30.aud.wiley.11479.sbeok.shnf**: audience recording; 18 songs; 163 min; rated 2.91/5 by 11 [3]. Said about its sound: Audience tape is only for sentimental use; the taper's conversations with people during the show are audible, and the second-set soundboard likely sounds better; Audience recording is not the cleanest, but audience chatter does not obscure the music; Reviewer says Red Rocks acoustics are poor for taping because sound dissipates, so soundboards are the best option there [8][14][17]
- **gd78-08-30.set2-sbd.barbella.8038.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 12 songs; 123 min; rated 4.18/5 by 17 [4]. Said about its sound: Second-set soundboard is called superb, but set 1 is not of comparable quality; Soundboard is described as very clean, with Jerry's guitar and voice sounding wonderful [9][13]
- **gd1978-08-30.158131.aud-partial.hicks-fong.flac2448**: audience recording; 11 songs; 86 min [6]

## Around the show

- The band introduced new songs destined for Shakedown Street, including Stagger Lee, I Need A Miracle and If I Had the World to Give [10]
- Reviewer says Dark Star Orchestra recreated this show at the Showbox in Seattle and recommends that version, which had an encore [8]
- Reviewer finds the band sluggish, unlike the amazing back-to-back shows at the same venue the previous month [15]
- Reviewer says this was the first show after the band recorded Shakedown Street, and its laid-back second set was unusual [18]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1978-08-30.145135.sony.ecm270.nak301.severson.miller.clugston.flac1648**: taped by Mark Severson; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: 1st Set: Mark Severson's Master Audience Cassettes; Sony ECM-270 mics (row 20, seats 73-75)> Sony TC-158SD (Maxell UDXLII) 2nd Set: Mark… [1]. Also: Master cassettes came from Mark Severson; Charlie Miller transferred them, with Wiley's audience source patching short gaps in The Other One and Drums [1]
- **gd78-08-30.aud.wiley.11479.sbeok.shnf**: source: Audience Recording [3]
- **gd78-08-30.set2-sbd.barbella.8038.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard [4]. Also: Charlie Miller is credited with the soundboard work; two Drums files are identical except that one runs a couple seconds longer [9]
- **gd1978-08-30.158131.aud-partial.hicks-fong.flac2448**: taped by concert recording by John Hicks & Dennis Fong; transferred by Transferred by Andrew F. 09/2022; source: Handheld deck (mono) > MAC > 1st-Gen mix tape [6]. Also: Partial audience tape possibly made on a portable Panasonic held at head level; it documents the three new songs; Source is mono and patched with a chunk from ID-11479 covering part of Eyes Of The World [6]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [Grateful Dead Red Rocks Amphitheater Morrison CO 7/8/78 3 CD CD's | #4595269627](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/grateful-dead-red-rocks-amphitheater-4595269627) [20]
